thread:
Ben: Quick sync  we need a lightweight "rollout-warden" design for canary fallbacks. local fast decisions + central policy. thoughts?

Yara: Local watcher sidecar for sub-second probes, central warden for leases/audit. Hybrid is the sweet spot.

Omar: Agree. Keep local logic simple: median+p90 over short windows, require 3 consecutive windows before soft-fallback.

Pri: Soft-fallback should ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 2s steps to preserve cache warmth. Emit a "recommend" event to warden at start.

Ben: Warden issues short TTL leases (30s) with allowed_fraction. If no lease, locals use conservative defaults (only escalate on extreme signals).

Yara: Metrics contract: push every 5s {region, p50,p90,p99,err,nsamples,last_probe}. Keep payload tiny. Warden subscribes for global reconciliation.

Omar: Failure modes: ledger down -> locals require 2x thresholds + 6 windows; oscillation -> cooldown 120s after full fallback; credit exhaustion -> route to degraded fallback variant.

Pri: Ops: one-click force-unwind + audit trail in warden. RBAC-protected. Also provide small CLI to query live leases.

deploy-bot: Canary launched model=dialogue-v5 region=us-west pilot=6%. Monitoring topics subscribed.

Ben: Thanks  I'll write a short RFC with the state machine, lease API proto, and metrics schema. @Omar will stub the sidecar binary.

Omar: On it, will keep it tiny and dependency-free.
